summary: Both editions cover the selected Greek clauses and preserve the principal assertions, negations, speakers, and reader-facing servant terminology. The fruit-reading and restored-blessing notes accurately reflect the supplied project reports; their disclosed working readings need not be replaced merely because alternatives exist.
